judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning file (`.lore/dod.md`) and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without writing any production implementation code at all. None of the source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc.) or documentation/spec files were modified. As a result, the added test file will fail to compile and fail all tests because `createMessageHandler` does not accept the new arguments and `validateMessage` does not support `list_conversations`. Furthermore, the candidate explicitly marked required documentation and changelog updates as 'Out of scope' in its DoD despite them being explicit acceptance criteria in the issue.
